name: Signal Detect Measure Expansion Inventory
summary: Declarative refinements for pipelines that filter a signal, detect events, and compute event-level measurements.

operations.name: Estimate SNR Before Filter
operations.intent: Assess signal-to-noise ratio before detection-oriented filtering commits to a conditioning path.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add an SNR check before filtering when the signal may be too noisy.

rewrite.before_summary: The source signal feeds the detection filter directly.
rewrite.after_summary: An SNR estimation stage is inserted before detection filtering.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds noise evidence before downstream event detection.

operations.name: Analyze Threshold Sensitivity
operations.intent: Expose whether detected event counts are brittle with respect to the peak threshold.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a check for whether small threshold changes cause large detection changes.

rewrite.before_summary: The filtered signal feeds downstream detection directly.
rewrite.after_summary: A threshold-sensitivity analysis stage is inserted after filtering.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds robustness evidence for the detection threshold.

operations.name: Check Event Rate Stationarity
operations.intent: Identify non-stationary event timing before the rate measure is interpreted as stable.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a check for whether the event rate changes too much over time.

rewrite.before_summary: Detected peaks feed the measurement path directly.
rewrite.after_summary: A rate-stationarity check is inserted after peak detection.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds timing-stability evidence before final measurement.

operations.name: Estimate False Positive Rate
operations.intent: Quantify unreliable detections after rate computation when detection noise may bias the measure.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a false-positive estimate after computing the event rate.

rewrite.before_summary: The computed rate feeds the downstream result directly.
rewrite.after_summary: A false-positive-rate estimation stage is inserted after rate computation.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds reliability evidence for the event measurement.

audit.rationale: Externalizes implemented signal detect/measure expansion operations into provider-owned declarative assets.
audit.dejargonized_summary: These are checks that make event detection and measurement pipelines more explicit when noise, threshold brittleness, non-stationarity, or false positives are present.

references.title: Matcher signal_detect_measure expansion rules
references.note: Rule names and trigger metrics mirror sciona/principal/expansion_rules/signal_detect_measure.py.
